title: Phenotypic Exploration During Sensory Stimulation in an Acoustic Chamber
official: Exploration phénotypique en Contexte de Stimulations Sensorielles en Chambre Acoustique
summary: An observational behavioural and neurophysiological study of the effects of controlled sensory stimulation (such as music, for example) on brain function
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* For patients : epilepsy
* For healthy volunteers: age \> 18 yo

Exclusion Criteria:

* For patients and healthy volonteers : Deafness
* For healthy volunteers : History of neurological conditions (including stroke, coma, epilepsy, neuro-inflammatory or neurodegenerative disease) or diagnosed cognitive impairment
